Bettina, I saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It is not sent.

It is a new draft, not an edit of Sofia's. Sofia's earlier draft ("PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living") is still in her mailbox, so you may want to delete it or let her know.

The draft adds your two lines: Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments, and Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. It also keeps the rename, the old "Covey — Late Arrivals" report label, and the request to update that label.
